subject: Request: Extended evaluation funding + term exception for Aurelia Health
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Extended evaluation funding + term exception for Aurelia Health

Team —

Quick background: Aurelia Health (large regional provider, potential ARR > $1.1M) is mid-POC but procurement pushed their review window because their CISO insisted on an in-depth network review and on-prem proof points. Their trial credits and the default 14-day evaluation window will expire before they can complete the security review.

Why this matters: they are a high-signal opportunity (clinical workflows + multi-year SaaS license expected), and a competitor is circling. We need a short bridge to keep them engaged and collect SOC2 artifacts so their security team completes the evaluation.

Ask: 1) Approve an evaluation credit top-up of $60,000 (hosted inference token-equivalent) and 2) extend the POC window by 30 days beyond standard PLG limits. This is an exception request (non-standard) and I can accept conditional requirements: signed LOI committing to run a single production pilot within 90 days OR a short-term purchase order to inventory credits.

Attachments: mutual action plan, draft MSA, SOC2 extract (stated).

Timing: Procurement asked for a decision this week to keep momentum — ideally approval by COB Mon (4/19).

Appreciate the quick review — happy to jump on a 15 min call to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extended evaluation funding + term exception for Aurelia Health

Sergio —

Thanks for the summary. A few quick clarifying questions before I escalate to Deal Desk/Finance for approval:

- Can you confirm the ARR motion and the expected first-year committed spend if they convert? (rough numbers are fine)
- Is the SOC2 extract full evidence or a partial export? Security will want to see the specific control narratives around data residency and access controls.
- Do we have a signed non-binding LOI draft or an email of intent from their procurement?

Assuming the ask is $60k + 30 days, please add a 1-paragraph ROI / conversion hypothesis and attach the LOI draft. Also flag whether this credit should be logged as a sales concession for quarters and who should own the concession review (Finance vs Sales Ops).

Looping in Laura for any managerial comments.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extended evaluation funding + term exception for Aurelia Health

Neha / Laura / Rishi —

Thanks — answers inline and attached updated packet (mutual action plan + LOI draft + ROI note).

- ARR / expected first-year committed spend: conservative estimate $1.1M ARR; expected first-year contract ~$650k (pilot + initial production nodes), with upsell potential to enterprise licensing across 4 regions in year 2.
- SOC2 extract: attached is a curated SOC2 export the CISO requested (controls 6, 9, 11 highlighted). It's not the full report but enough for their initial review; they asked to see early evidence rather than the full PDF.
- LOI: attached a one-page LOI draft from Aurelia (Priya Shah confirmed via email that procurement can sign a short LOI to unlock extended test data).

ROI / conversion hypothesis (1 paragraph): If we provide continuity across the security review (credits + 30-day extension) Aurelia will complete the network review and run a production pilot that is forecasted to lead to a $650k initial contract within 60 days after pilot completion (50% probability of conversion within 6 months). Incremental CAC is low relative to expected deal size because the sales cycle is near completion on product fit; the credit is a retention/activation lever rather than pure acquisition spend.

Proposed acceptance criteria (sales-side):
- Signed LOI (non-binding) from Aurelia committing to pilot scope and timeline
- Confirmed SOC2 artifact delivery within 7 days of credit release
- Single-pilot POC to run in our hosted environment with telemetry sharing enabled for 30 days

Concession logging: Please record this as a sales concession against Q2 with Sergio as owner; recommend Finance review and tag as one-time evaluation credit.

If approved, I will: 1) push the credit into their account, 2) set the eval window +30 days, and 3) book follow-up with the CISO to confirm evidence handoff.

Attachments included: Aurelia_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx; Draft_MSA_Aurelia_v1.pdf; SOC2-extract.zip; LOI_Aurelia_signed_draft.pdf

Can we get an exception decision by Monday EOD? Happy to join a quick call with Finance/Legal if helpful.

— Sergio
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Extended evaluation funding + term exception for Aurelia Health

Team —

Appreciate the clear packet and the runway rationale. I will approve a conditional exception as follows:

- Approval: $60,000 evaluation credit equivalent and a 30-day evaluation extension beyond the standard PLG window.
- Conditions: 1) A signed LOI (even if non-binding) must be executed before credits are applied; 2) SOC2 artifact (controls extract) must be uploaded to the secure intake folder; 3) Finance must record this as a sales concession for Q2 and route to Revenue Ops for tracking.

Operational notes: Sergio — do not provision credits until Legal confirms the LOI language and Finance acknowledges concession logging. Neha / Laura — please confirm the concession code and whether any additional approvals (CFO) are required for reporting.

I'll mark this closed on my end if the LOI and SOC2 pieces are in place by EOD Tue (4/20). Good work keeping this live.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0142
